caption: The drawing depicts an open chest or box with the lid raised. The box is predominantly colored in deep red and maroon tones, accented by gold or brass-colored hardware, including corner brackets, rivets, and a large central lock plate on the front. The front face of the box features detailed paneling, with geometric patterns and a central triangular design flanked by rectangular and diamond shapes. The inside of the lid is lined with a diamond-patterned, light blue or silver surface, possibly meant to resemble quilted fabric or metal. Hanging from a latch inside the lid is a circular medallion or ornament displaying an image of a person wearing a hat and holding a small object, painted in multiple colors including green, pink, red, and beige. A green ribbon or tassel is attached to the medallion. The right interior section of the box shows a rectangular compartment or shelf, shaded in blue tones, with varying hues to indicate depth and shadow. The overall composition is centered on a neutral, light beige background, with no additional objects or scenery present in the image.
title: Doll's Trunk
